name: ATMA Miami by Aman
statusRemark: A 1,049-foot Brickell Bay landmark by Aman Group's ATMA brand.
description: ATMA Miami is a 1,049-foot residential tower planned for the Brickell bayfront at 1111 Brickell Bay Drive. The project introduces Aman Group's performance-led ATMA wellness brand with one- through five-bedroom residences ranging from 813 to 7,200 square feet, a planned 120,000-square-foot wellness center and a nine-court racquet club.
editorialLine: A new standard for wellness on Brickell Bay.

amenities.label: Nine-court racquet club
amenities.sub: Indoor tennis and padel over Biscayne Bay

amenities.label: Private residential arrival
amenities.sub: Dedicated lobby, lifts, valet and concierge

amenitiesDescription:
ATMA Miami is planned around a 120,000-square-foot spa and wellness center, with training floors, mobility and conditioning labs, medical wellness and recovery suites. Residents will have access to a pool, fitness and training studio, coworking and lounge spaces, concierge and valet.

The racquet and aquatic program includes a nine-court club for indoor tennis and padel overlooking Biscayne Bay, plus an adjacent marina. The development also plans six dining and entertaining destinations, including a mixology bar and events space.
